newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Three Israeli soldiers dead, seven hurt in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Three Israeli soldiers dead, seven hurt in Lebanon.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were killed and seven wounded on Thursday in fierce clashes with Hizbollah guerrillas in south Lebanon, Israeli security sources said on Friday.
Pro-Israeli militia sources had initially reported that one soldier was killed and five wounded in the fighting.
The fighting on Thursday night was the bloodiest clash in south Lebanon in nearly two months, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

Later, Israeli helicopters twice struck Hizbollah bases just outside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone. In a separate air raid, a helicopter rocketed a Lebanese army checkpoint north of the zone, Lebanese security sources said.
The fighting occurred as a group of Israeli soldiers got caught in a guerrilla ambush in ad-Dahr Daidaba south of Syrian-controlled Bekaa valley, two kms (one mile) north of Israel's occupation zone.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) said its guerrillas ambushed the group as they attempted to infiltrate outside the zone.
